messages.subject: Installer packages for Windows and Mac OS X
messages.subject_clean: Installer packages for Windows and Mac OS X
messages.body_plain:
I have just created installers that bundle R, JGR and Deducer into one installation process. Simply double click on the installer, and it will install the latest version of R (if needed), the JGR launcher, as well as the JGR and Deducer packages. All Windows operating systems are supported (XP, Vista, Windows 7, etc.), and on the Mac, I have made installers for Mac OS 10.4 and 10.5. I should have a version for Mac OS 10.6 in the near future, but I have to get a hold of a test system.

The installers are available at:
http://www.deducer.org/pmwiki/index.php?n=Main.DownloadingAndInstallingDeducer

By necessity I have only tested these on a very limited set of systems, so please let me know if you have any installation issues on your system.

Cheers,
Ian
